# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser canvas arcade game called “Woodsboro Rulebreaker Hotline.” Preserve a simple timed-collection survival loop: the player steers a final-girl avatar by tapping/dragging, glowing evidence clues spawn and mature, collecting ripe clues awards 10 evidence points, missed ripe clues become red failures and reduce suspicion/lives, and zero lives shows a restartable game-over overlay. Present it as a Scream-inspired meta-horror mystery with phone-call tension, whodunit suspicion, self-aware genre-rule jokes, a white masked stalker silhouette, police-tape suburban backlot, readable mobile HUD, and catalog-backed horror fonts/audio/GIF feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile canvas arcade collection / avoid-expiry survival loop
- objective: steer the avatar toward ripe/glowing pickups before their timers expire
- input model: pointer/touch down and drag on the canvas sets the avatar target; restart uses a normal button click
- core loop: spawn items, grow them into collectible urgent state, collect for +10 score, lose one life when an urgent item expires, continue until lives reach zero
- fail/friction state: expired urgent items reduce lives; zero lives opens a game-over/restart overlay

## Protected Mechanics
- Touch/click movement interpolation, spawn cadence, item growth/ripe/rotting timers, collision radius collection, score increments, life loss, game-over at zero, and restart reset are preserved.

## Remix Premise
Woodsboro Rulebreaker Hotline reframes the same loop as a final girl collecting evidence phones and VHS clues before the caller turns each missed clue into suspicion and chase pressure.
